Keep the pre-pin controls executing the real pre-pin source, and keep the C6 archive witness, by content-addressed pins stored where the test runner and the typechecker do not treat them as live sources. Leave git ancestry in force for an explicit throwaway boundary. The behavior pass is recorded by ngrace gate verdict running a portable verifier against the Validate job's exact-head JUnit artifact. Goals.Goal: The two pre-pin controls execute cleanupCandidate and the reclaim lock from the src tree of b53d13df47cdf8d85f75b33502c6ecd9e97ff262. That tree is stored as a deterministic archive plus manifest under scripts/fixtures/prepin-b53d13df47cdf8d85f75b33502c6ecd9e97ff262/, extracted into a throwaway temp root at test time, and imported from that temp root.

The in-repository C6 archived-mode call, which omits the boundary argument, is green when the C6 archive bytes match the six sha256 pairs in the content-witness Constraint and the recorded historical path list is exactly the twelve paths in that Constraint. The call does not spawn git.

An explicit boundary argument keeps today's git ancestry, historical diff, and archive-byte checks, and fails closed when that boundary object is absent or is not an ancestor of that repository's HEAD.

The Validate job on ubuntu-latest executes the two pre-pin controls in a checkout of the exact commit being closed and uploads their JUnit report and a head stamp. The post-archive ngrace gate verdict runs the portable verifier against that artifact and is the write of the CloseEvidence result into run-ledger.xml. The workflow does not run ngrace gate verdict and does not write that ledger.

It does not answer it by ignoring a drifted archive. Archived C-FINAL-HEAD-ACTIVE-DIR-1-A69D80C1 is not edited. D25 does not cover this write: a green result contradicts that archived acceptance criterion, so this bundle is the governed successor rather than an ungoverned test hotfix.

Linux behavior evidence, exact head. .github/workflows/validate.yml gains steps at the end of the existing validate job. That job stays runs-on ubuntu-latest. Its first checkout keeps fetch-depth 0 and is not retargeted. The added steps check out the event head into a subdirectory: the pull-request head sha when the event is pull_request, otherwise the pushed sha, with fetch-depth 0. In that subdirectory they run bun install --frozen-lockfile and bun test --timeout=0 src/grace-generate.test.ts src/grace-cursor.test.ts -t b53d13d --reporter=junit, writing prepin-behavior-junit.xml. They write git rev-parse HEAD of that checkout to prepin-behavior-head.txt. They upload both files with actions/upload-artifact@v7 under the artifact name prepin-behavior-junit, including when the test step has failed, and the upload fails the job when either file is missing. The job does not run ngrace gate verdict and does not commit run-ledger.xml. A failing pre-pin step fails the validate job, the required status check named validate. The portable verifier is scripts/verify-prepin-linux-evidence.ts. Its filename does not contain .test, so scripts/test-metrics.ts does not list it and a default bun test discovery does not run it. It contains one bun:test test, no environment switch, and no argument that accepts a local report. The test reads git rev-parse HEAD, requires a 40-character lowercase hex sha, and runs gh run list --commit of that sha --workflow validate.yml --limit 20 --json databaseId,headSha,status,conclusion. A missing gh binary or a failed gh invocation fails the test. The list is newest first. It uses the first object whose headSha equals that sha, and it does not fall through to an older run. No such object, a status other than completed, or a conclusion other than success fails the test. It downloads artifact prepin-behavior-junit for that databaseId into a temporary directory, requires the trimmed head stamp to equal the sha, and reads the JUnit file. It parses each <testcase> element from its opening tag through a self-closing end or the matching close tag. Exactly one element must carry each of the two control titles. That element's body must not contain an element named skipped, failure, or error, written as <skipped>, <failure>, or <error>. Every other <testcase> is ignored, including a <skipped> element created by the name filter. A missing title, a duplicate title, or a forbidden child fails the test. ngrace gate verdict, run in a checkout whose HEAD is that sha after this bundle is applied and archived, evaluates the CloseEvidence command and writes the criterion's Exit and Result into .ngrace/changes/archive/C-SQUASH-WITNESS-1-87D77A3D/run-ledger.xml. A non-zero command refuses outcome pass. A green Validate run without that verdict writes no CloseEvidence child.
